announcements.headline: Preference Dividend Declaration
announcements.insight: AECI LD declares a preference dividend. This follows earlier interest payment notifications in June and September 2026.

announcements.headline: Interest and Capital Payment Notification
announcements.insight: Interest payments follow August's consent request. Shareholders should monitor for further court sanction steps.

announcements.headline: Dealings in securities by Directors, Prescribed Officers and the Group Company Secretary
announcements.insight: Director dealings are routine governance updates. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for any strategic shifts following the recent noteholder consent process.

announcements.headline: Voting results in respect of the request for written consent of Noteholders of AECI06 Notes
announcements.insight: Voting results for AECI06 Noteholders follow the June 2026 interest payment notifications. This confirms the outcome of the written consent request regarding the notes.

Interest Payment Notifications
